d: Two debates are putting accountability and power under the spotlight. The U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom has urged sanctions against RSS members over alleged religious-freedom violations and called for Washington to deny senior RSS leaders high-level meetings and diplomatic courtesies, ahead of Mohan Bhagwat’s planned August 29 visit to New York. India has rejected USCIRF’s criticism as “distorted and selective,” while America’s own record on religious freedom and hate crimes—including rising anti-Sikh and anti-Hindu incidents—faces scrutiny.
